description: This file defines the class `HTMLPurifier_PercentEncoder`, responsible for handling percent-encoding operations within URI processing, including encoding and normalization of percent-encoded strings.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_PercentEncoder
classes.description: A class that manages percent-encoding operations for URIs, including encoding strings and normalizing percent-encoded sequences.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the set of characters to preserve during encoding, with optional extra preservation based on input.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Replaces URL encoding by percent-encoding all non-reserved characters and additional preserved characters.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Fixes up percent-encoding by decoding unreserved characters and normalizing percent-encoded sequences.
